table.name: Cartoon
table.purpose: Episode list of the animated series 'Batman: The Brave and the Bold' (episode titles, air dates, production codes, director and writer, and the channel on which it aired).

Channel.name: Channel
Channel.description: ID of the TV channel that aired the episode; references TV_Channel.id (music channels such as Sky Music, MTV Hits).

Directed_by.name: Directed_by
Directed_by.description: Name of the episode's director (Ben Jones, Brandon Vietti, Michael Chang).

Original_air_date.name: Original_air_date
Original_air_date.description: Original US air date of the episode, stored as text like 'November21,2008' (no space after month name).

Production_code.name: Production_code
Production_code.description: Episode production code (101–112), i.e. season 1 episodes 1–12.

Title.name: Title
Title.description: Title of the episode (e.g. 'Day of the Dark Knight!').

Written_by.name: Written_by
Written_by.description: Name of the episode's writer (e.g. J. M. DeMatteis, Steven Melching).

id.name: id
id.description: Primary key; sequential episode row identifier (1–12).

table.name: TV_Channel
table.purpose: Lookup table of music TV channels (mostly Italian Sky platform channels), with country, language, package, aspect ratio and HD/PPV flags.

Content.name: Content
Content.description: Genre of the channel's content; all rows are 'music'.

Country.name: Country
Country.description: Country of the channel (Italy, United Kingdom, Poland).

Hight_definition_TV.name: Hight_definition_TV
Hight_definition_TV.description: Whether the channel broadcasts in high definition ('yes'/'no'; misspelled column name).

Language.name: Language
Language.description: Broadcast language of the channel (Italian or English).

Package_Option.name: Package_Option
Package_Option.description: Pay-TV package in which the channel is offered (e.g. 'Sky Famiglia', 'Sky Famiglia + Sky HD', 'no ( FTV )' = free-to-view, 'Option').

Pay_per_view_PPV.name: Pay_per_view_PPV
Pay_per_view_PPV.description: Whether the channel is pay-per-view; all rows are 'no'.

Pixel_aspect_ratio_PAR.name: Pixel_aspect_ratio_PAR
Pixel_aspect_ratio_PAR.description: Pixel aspect ratio of the broadcast (4:3, 16:9, or both '4:3 / 16:9').

id.name: id
id.description: Primary key; channel number (700–728), referenced by Cartoon.Channel and TV_series.Channel.

series_name.name: series_name
series_name.description: Name of the channel (e.g. 'Sky Music', 'MTV Hits', 'MTV Dance'); despite the column name it denotes the channel, not a series.

table.name: TV_series
table.purpose: Episode-by-episode US television ratings data for a 2007 TV series (episode titles and air dates match the drama 'Journeyman'), including viewers, rating/share and weekly rank.

18_49_Rating_Share.name: 18_49_Rating_Share
18_49_Rating_Share.description: Nielsen rating/share among adults 18–49 for the episode, formatted 'rating/share' (e.g. '2.4/6').

Air_Date.name: Air_Date
Air_Date.description: Original air date of the episode (e.g. 'October 1, 2007').

Channel.name: Channel
Channel.description: ID of the TV channel; references TV_Channel.id. Note: the referenced channels are music channels, so this join is likely a spurious/statistical artifact rather than a real broadcast relationship.

Rating.name: Rating
Rating.description: Nielsen household rating of the episode (percent of households, e.g. 3.7). The detected join to Cartoon.id is coincidental (both are 1–12 sequences), not a real reference.

Share.name: Share
Share.description: Share of households watching TV that were watching this episode (5–9 percent). The join to Cartoon.id is coincidental, not a real reference.

Viewers_m.name: Viewers_m
Viewers_m.description: Number of viewers in millions (4.24–9.16). The one-to-one join to Cartoon.id is coincidental (both tables have 12 rows numbered 1–12), not a real reference.

Weekly_Rank.name: Weekly_Rank
Weekly_Rank.description: Rank of the episode's broadcast among all network programming for that week (43–80).

id.name: id
id.description: Primary key; sequential episode row identifier (1–12).
